title: Clarify null ambiguity in FileNode: directory vs legacy file
description: Both directory FileNodes and pre-capability file FileNodes return sha256: null (lines 190-201). A client cannot distinguish the cause without separately inspecting the FileNode type. Add explicit guidance: 'Clients MUST check the FileNode type before interpreting a null sha256 value; null for a directory FileNode is expected, while null for a file FileNode indicates a legacy entry with no computed digest.'
close_reason: Updated FileNode Client Usage to require MUST check FileNode type to distinguish directory (null expected) from legacy file (null = unverified). Also fixed imprecise earlier null description.
